caption:
Holiday weekend? Here's a 12-minute golf workout you can do anywhere. 🏌️

1. Lunge + Rotation: 6 each side
2. Single-Leg Bridge: 8 each side
3. Side Plank: 20-30 s each side
4. Dead Bug: 6 each side
3 rounds, 45-60 s rest between rounds. All you need is a golf club.

✅ Smooth reps, full control
❌ Don't rush the turn or let the hips sag

Save this for your next trip.

More free golf fitness: physioforegolf.com (link in bio)
